About BookFunnel

BookFunnel is an ebook delivery service! We want you to get your book as quickly and as painlessly as possible.

Our clients are our authors, and we love them just as much as you do. BookFunnel.com will not start emailing you books or other free offers— we don’t even have a reader mailing list! We are here solely to help you get their free book downloaded so that you can curl up with it and start reading ASAP.

How does this work?

BookFunnel provides step-by-step instructions to download your book so that you can start reading ASAP.

Depending on your device, that may take a couple of clicks, or it may take… a bit more than that! We deliver thousands of books every hour, to readers all over the world.

Click through the instructions for your device and give it a shot. If you get stuck in the middle, no problem. Just click the Need Help? at the top of the book page to let a member of our support staff know you are having trouble.
